text:
sam: Quick heads-up  starting a compact entitlement sweep now (scope: admin roles inactive >60d, ephemeral-svcaccounts, and KMS keys with cross-project grants). Goal: evidence tickets only; no auto-prune without manual signoff.
anya: Thumbs up. Can we also flag any role bindings that were created by terraform but not tracked in the ownership registry? Those are pain points later.
sam: Good call  pipeline will diff terraform-state bindings vs ownership-registry and tag mismatches as "infra-untracked".
chip: For KMS, watch HSM-backed keys: they have rotation constraints. If rotation_recent=true skip automated suggestions. Also prefer to collect last 3 decrypt actors.
sam: Noted. We'll tag rotation_recent and include last_3_actors in the ticket.
sec-bot: recert-scan initiated by sam at 2026-07-12T16:00:03Z. Scanning IAM, KMS grants, and service-account use. ETA ~6m.
anya: Question on owner tickets: do we route to the ownership registry email or to the raw principal email? Some owners are aliases that route to groups.
sam: Route to ownership registry if present, otherwise to principal email. Add cc to "access-cert-steward@redwood" for escalation.
devsec: On vuln triage side  any admin roles tied to older runtime images (CVE window) should get bumped priority. If an admin is only in a project running EOL images, flag it as risk-level "image:cve-high".
chip: For audit coverage: quick gcloud command to pull decrypt events:
```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt"' --limit 200 --freshness=90d --format=json | jq -r '.[] | {key: .resource.labels.key_name, actor: .protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, ts: .timestamp} | @json'
```
pipe that into the runbook extractor.
sec-bot: collection finished at 2026-07-12T16:05:48Z. Summary: 4,020 bindings scanned, 142 admin roles last-active>60d, 73 infra-untracked bindings, 56 KMS grants flagged cross-project, 22 HSM-backed keys, 81 ephemeral SAs. Creating 278 owner-evidence tickets.
anya: Pager note: owner email blasts sometimes coincide with oncall pages. infra-oncall: can we add header X-Notify-Quiet for known oncall aliases and rate-limit to 60/hr?
infra-oncall: yes, please add X-Notify-Quiet and a 90m window suppression for aliases flagged as oncall. Also include a short remediation checklist in the email to reduce follow-ups.
sam: We'll add a one-click "I own this" action in the ticket template that records acceptance and timestamps. If no ack in 5 days escalate to access-cert-steward.
devsec: For incident response linkage  if a key is both ownerless and shows decrypt activity from an external principal, open a critical vuln-triage card and ping irs@redwood.
anya: Also include a note for KMS keys used by batch pipelines: mark them "cron-protected" and require manual human review before any revoke.
sam: Plan recap: 1) run now and create tickets (done) 2) 5d owner response window 3) escalate ownerless or risky items to access-cert-steward + infra-oncall 4) manual remediation only by oncall with runbook checklist. Volunteers: @anya for ticket template, @chip for KMS last-actor extraction, @devsec for vuln-prioritization rules.
sec-bot: tickets created: recert-20260712-278. Tags: infra-untracked(73), cross-project-kms(56), hsm(22), ephemeral-sa(81), image:cve-high(14).
sam: Great work. After responses come in let's run a dry-run revoke report and post it here before any manual steps. :thumbsup:
